framework: BHIL VAULT (Verified Asset Universe & Landscape Taxonomy)

assets.description: Creator-published lexicon and grammar of tlhIngan Hol; the canonical anchor of Klingon data.
assets.strategic_value: Gold-standard creator-published, franchise-licensed conlang dataset.

metrics.name: words_1985_edition
metrics.source: Goodreads review; order corroborated by Wikipedia (~1,800)

assets.description: Post-TKD canonical additions from confirmed Okrand sources, each entry source-cited.
assets.strategic_value: The canonical-labeling exemplar: every entry carries provenance.

assets.description: XML-backed lexicon of all Tolkien's invented languages with period stratification and stable per-reference identifiers.
assets.strategic_value: Only conlang dataset on a formal data model with an open license and stable IDs; Croissant pilot candidate.

metrics.name: lexical_entries
metrics.source: Fenopaedia description; no exact integer published

assets.description: Aggregated collaborative Elvish dictionary importing multiple quality sources, searchable by sense and conjugation.
assets.strategic_value: Largest aggregated Elvish lookup surface; illustrates aggregation-versus-canon tension.

assets.description: Most comprehensive fan-maintained Na'vi lexicon, source-tagged per word; canon authority Paul Frommer.
assets.strategic_value: Best example of creator-community co-development with explicit canon labeling.

assets.description: Creator-hosted Dothraki lexicon with IPA, part of speech, and glossed example sentences.
assets.license: All rights reserved (franchise IP); creator-hosted docs
assets.strategic_value: First conlang built for a major TV production; deep culture-clustered vocabulary.

assets.description: Dictionary of the Skyrim dragon language distinguishing canonical from fan-made entries; dual role as dataset and hosting institution.
assets.distribution: Web; PDF print editions; CSV/Excel export
assets.strategic_value: Clearest canon-versus-reconstruction case study in the domain.
assets.notes: Site largely unmaintained since early 2019; expanded metrics decayed one tier.

assets.description: English-based creole for The Expanse with wide multilingual lexical influence; distinct novel and TV versions.
assets.strategic_value: Only major creole conlang; strong candidate for sociolinguistic tagging.

assets.description: Expanded Fremen language of the 2021/2024 films with full grammar, lexicon, and a custom abugida script.

provenance.owner: Legendary (IP); David J. and Jessie Peterson (language)
provenance.author: David J. Peterson; Jessie Peterson

assets.distribution: Film dialogue; creator documentation; Omniglot reference
assets.strategic_value: Recent high-visibility film conlang with a canonical constructed script.

assets.description: Claimed first large-scale conlang NLP benchmark across 21 constructed languages.
assets.strategic_value: If genuine and openly licensed, partially closes white-space item 1.
assets.notes: Future-dated arXiv identifier at run time; verification pending.

assets.description: 15,000 English captions machine-translated into Klingon pIqaD via Bing Translator for low-resource MT experiments.
assets.strategic_value: Concrete precedent for conlangs as low-resource MT testbeds.

assets.description: Largest language-learning platform; carries High Valyrian and Klingon (Esperanto at the auxlang boundary).
assets.strategic_value: Dominant conlang distribution channel and largest audience funnel; all metrics vendor self-reported.
assets.notes: Public counters frozen since 2025-06-23; metrics decayed. Klingon course closed to new users.

assets.description: Canon-guarding institution for Klingon: new-word ledger, HolQeD journal (1992-2004), annual qep'a', certification program.
assets.strategic_value: The archetypal guards_canon_of node; partner to Duolingo and Microsoft.

assets.description: Encyclopedia of writing systems and languages; central cross-franchise reference hub for constructed and fictional scripts.
assets.strategic_value: Best cross-franchise script-reference aggregator.

metrics.name: constructed_scripts
metrics.source: site self-report; order corroborated by Wikipedia

assets.description: Community organization invited by Paul Frommer to co-develop Na'vi; hosts the authoritative dictionary, audio, and lessons.
assets.strategic_value: Best-practice creator-community hosts and teaches node; live canon feed from naviteri.org.

assets.description: The professional body of conlanging; staffed HBO's Dothraki search, runs Fiat Lingua, Lexember, and the LCC conferences.

provenance.author: Founded 2007; historically led by Sai Emrys

assets.strategic_value: The field's professional-network hub connecting creators to studios.

assets.description: The de facto journal of conlang scholarship; monthly CC-licensed PDF archive since 2011.
assets.strategic_value: The domain's citable scholarly record and natural cites backbone.

assets.asset_name: Publisher Channels (Pocket Books; Penguin Random House / Living Language)
assets.description: The licensed, ISBN-anchored commercial layer distributing the canonical printed conlang assets.
assets.strategic_value: Where franchise IP and conlang data formally intersect.

assets.asset_name: App Stores (Google Play / Apple App Store)
assets.description: Distribution channel for conlang apps, principally boQwI'.
assets.strategic_value: The mobile distribution layer; all figures are store self-reports.

assets.description: Distributed hosting of conlang lexicons and grammars across wiki platforms.
assets.strategic_value: High reach, low provenance discipline; the fragmentation problem in microcosm.

assets.description: Tolkien's own writing systems with canonical charts; indexed by Mellonath Daeron's DTS/DCS specimina catalogs.
assets.license: All rights reserved (estate); scholarly reproduction fair-use
assets.strategic_value: The most-reproduced conlang visualization set; core of any script-chart product.

assets.description: The Klingon writing system, decorative on screen with Latin transliteration as working orthography; digital support in Bing Translator and dCode.
assets.strategic_value: Iconic franchise script with digital tooling support.

assets.description: The dragon runic script carved on Skyrim's Word Walls; per-word rune spellings in the Thuum.org Fourth Edition dictionary; fan fonts exist.
assets.strategic_value: Game-native script with strong visual-merchandise potential.

assets.description: Left-to-right abugida designed for the 2021/2024 films; consonant glyphs change shape by attached vowel; official typeable font.
assets.strategic_value: Newest canonical constructed script with an official font.

assets.description: Tolkien's own diagrams of Elvish descent, reflected in Eldamo's period model and Fauskanger's evolution analyses.
assets.strategic_value: The canonical derived_from visualization; a template for conlang genealogy diagrams.

assets.description: Open-source desktop conlang toolkit: lexicon, grammar guide, auto conjugation, orthography, etymology trees, word generator, audio.
assets.strategic_value: Leading free and open desktop documentation tool; natural export target for a standardized format.

assets.description: One-click commercial generator of phonology, grammar, and lexicon, with a sound-change tool and online dictionary deployment.
assets.strategic_value: Dominant commercial generator; strong for rapid worldbuilding.

assets.description: Web-based conlang creation and community platform with courses and the CALS cross-conlang typological atlas.
assets.strategic_value: The community and analytics layer; CALS is a rare structured typological dataset for conlangs.

assets.description: Browser-based tool applying ordered sound changes to a lexicon to derive descendants or reconstruct proto-forms.
assets.strategic_value: The canonical diachronic tool and reference implementation.

assets.description: Successor-class sound-change applier and word generator with multigraph support, suprasegmentals, and daughter-language derivation.
assets.strategic_value: The modern power-user SCA.

assets.description: Klingon lexicon, canon search, and grammar parser app, updated within days of qep'a' word reveals; open data repository.
assets.strategic_value: Best-in-class living-canon dictionary app; model for canon-tracked repositories.

assets.description: First and only commercial-grade conlang MT engine, built with the KLI, Marc Okrand, and Microsoft engineer Eric Andeen; Latin and pIqaD output.

provenance.author: Microsoft Translator team with KLI and Okrand

assets.strategic_value: The only commercial conlang MT; its pipeline seeded academic MT experiments.

assets.description: The scholarly backbone of Elvish study: grammars, corpus analyses, the Quenya Course, and the Quettaparma Quenyallo wordlist.
assets.strategic_value: Primary scholarly source feeding Eldamo and Elfdict.

assets.description: Official conversational Dothraki course: 128-page guide plus one-hour audio CD, 500+ words and phrases including course-exclusive coinage.

provenance.owner: HBO (IP); Penguin Random House / Living Language (publisher)
provenance.author: David J. Peterson

assets.strategic_value: Canonical licensed learning product for a screen conlang; commercial precedent for the GamingToolset line.

assets.description: The definitive practitioner's manual for conlang construction, with companion online course and video series.
assets.strategic_value: The field's canonical methodology reference and citation anchor.

assets.description: Multi-stage LLM pipeline generating internally consistent, typologically diverse conlangs, treating model confabulation as a creative feature.
assets.strategic_value: State of the art in AI conlang generation; the emerging AI-tool frontier.
